M-WIDGET-EMITTER.Purpose: Emission stage of the widget generator: orchestrate per-widget emitters to produce partial classes with property setters, lifecycle hooks, ref structures and inherited-context consumer updates.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Emitter orchestration over widget models (Emitters/*, WidgetEmitter).
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Generator pipeline wiring and source-text production (WidgetPipeline, WidgetProvider).
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Analysis and diagnostics — owned by M-REACTIVITY-ANALYZER.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Widget model schema — owned by M-WIDGET-MODELS.
Scope.SCP-OUT-003: Generator entry point and shared code-building/Roslyn/string utilities — owned by M-SOURCE-GENERATORS-COMMON.
Scope.SCP-OUT-004: IL redirection of auto-properties — owned by M-PROPERTY-WEAVER.

Requirements.REQ-001: Generated widget code compiles clean per SS-SOURCE-GENERATORS.REQ-002.
Requirements.REQ-002: For every inherited-context property the emitter generates Widget._Update{Prop}FromAncestor — the shared symbol with M-INHERITED-CONTEXT.
Requirements.REQ-003: Setter emission produces the _Set{Prop}/_Get{Prop} counterparts the weaver redirects to (M-PROPERTY-WEAVER).
Requirements.REQ-004: Widget member layout is derived from property names by fixed rules (SS-SOURCE-GENERATORS.REQ-003).
Requirements.REQ-005: The synchronized setter switches over LifecycleState, short-circuits on SemEquals, and activates/releases behaviors on the instance side.
Requirements.REQ-006: Definition initialization applies a shape-appropriate behavior default for every declared property kind.
Requirements.REQ-007: ApplyPropsFromDefinition re-applies [Prop] members on update; [State] members are instance-owned and never re-applied.
Requirements.REQ-008: InheritedContext emission registers providers, subscribes consumers by name+type, preserves field initializers and releases on deinit (shared seam with M-INHERITED-CONTEXT).
Requirements.REQ-009: Reactivity flags wire ReconcileChildren/MarkNodeAsDirty signals through Engine.Post; ordinary non-layout Props with absent flags emit no signals. Base Widget layout Props always apply their current Behavior.Value to Flexbox on assignment and OnUpdate.
Requirements.REQ-010: The Refs member emitter generates an explicit public string indexer `IPropertyRef this[string key]` on the widget's generated Refs struct/class.
Requirements.REQ-011: The generated `Refs[string key]` indexer uses an unallocated string switch over all visible local and inherited reactive property names, returning the corresponding IPropertyRef field, or null if the key is unrecognized.
Requirements.REQ-012: WidgetEmitter handles baseline [FVP] properties via its Fvp member emitter and includes them in Definition/Instance lifecycle, initialization, clone, release and unified Refs/Bind/Watch, without a second generated FVP pipeline for the same class.
Requirements.REQ-013: Fvp/Prop/State/InheritedContext explicitly emit their property fields, getters and complete setters, keeping specialized engine and context effects local to each emitter.
Requirements.REQ-014: Overrides inherit the reactive category of their base property when not explicitly annotated, reuse base slot storage and expose adapters that dispatch through the public override.
Requirements.REQ-015: ReleaseBehaviors clears each populated owned FVP/Prop/State slot with Changing and Changed before releasing the Behavior, allowing IPropertyRef observers to detect teardown before a Reset-triggered OnComplete.
Requirements.REQ-016: LayoutProperties maps only exact reserved names of base Widget slots to Flexbox operations. PropertyModel.SlotOwner preserves declaration identity through the Roslyn override chain; hidden user slots and decorative prefixes receive no layout route. Internal Flexbox Style types remain unchanged.
Requirements.REQ-017: Prop emits reserved layout slots through a separate Style signal block preserving the original assignment/OnUpdate FIFO actions. Ordinary Props retain their original reactivity-flag path; Behavior handlers retain the original Reset-based cleanup.

Inputs.IN-001: widget models: schema owned by M-WIDGET-MODELS.

Outputs.OUT-001: generated C# partial classes added to the compilation.
